geo._warning: All coordinates approximate. Replace with Clinton County Auditor parcel geometry.
geo.burden_note: Capacity-market cost does NOT spread by distance. There were zero constrained LDAs in the 2027/28 and 2028/29 PJM auctions, so the AEP and DAY zones paid the RTO-wide price and the cost is borne across all 13 PJM states. The arcs above show the GAS supply chain, not the ratepayer burden.

ledgers.label: Rents 400 acres nearby
ledgers.note: A renter pays the premium. A landowner collects it — opposite sign.

ledgers.label: Owns 400 acres nearby
ledgers.note: The farm community is not one interest. This split is the point.

ledgers.label: Fixed income, owns in town
ledgers.note: No wage exposure, so bears cost without the job upside.

ledgers.label: Trades, works the build
ledgers.note: Temporary. 12-18 months per building, then it ends.

ledgers.label: Takes a permanent job, lives in Highland County
ledgers.note: 62.9% of Clinton County jobs are already held by in-commuters. This worker's wage leaves the county and they pay no Wilmington electric bill — the benefit exports, the cost does not.

ledgers.label: Two children in Wilmington City Schools
ledgers.note: Under the 100% CRA the state-aid channel never fires; the PILOT runs instead.

school_aid_saturation.note: Linear to the threshold, then FLAT. Identical at $1B, $2B and $4B.
